set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O01.4
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer
Scope: Make the supported service lifecycle repeatable beyond a developer machine.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O01 (bd-01M4W40K19EDEPHZA7Y20F340Z)
Suggested delivery tranche: T2; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Rehearse installation and upgrade from the current schema using only the packaged artifact and documented configuration.
2. Verify old releases/exports and current access after upgrade; failed deployment can be recovered with the documented procedure.
3. Add repeatable CI jobs and retain actual run evidence before claiming execution; configuration alone is recorded as pending, not passed.
4. Consume the preserved old binary/catalog/blob oracle from H06.2; distinguish schema compatibility from scientific interpretation compatibility and reject unsupported downgrade or mixed-version writers.

Verification: Clean-host and executed CI receipts with artifact/source hashes, upgrade results and any unavailable hosted-run gate. An executed local CI runner is acceptable for the engineering profile only if it executes the declared jobs; hosted status remains explicitly unqualified until an actual hosted run exists.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O01.4/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala
- build.sbt
- docs/service-distribution.md
- scripts/check-service-package.py
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O01.2: bd-01M4W5P7PW6P6NZVCD0TEMRKKP
- O01.3: bd-01M4W5P7TR8CRP45DQQX3AFEV3
- H06.2: bd-01M4X8MB6FF93SWENVA4256H33

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O01.4: Exercise packaged install, upgrade and release evidence in CI
